test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given that will come in place of the question mark (?) and logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faaf807d897fa74c721a1b6d142118541e7934d489bb6fd929bf19bda558eb51.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) For the square element at the right top corner → Rotate 90º in the clockwise direction.

2) For the arrow element inside the rhombus shaped figure → Rotate 45º in the clockwise direction.

3) For the arrow point element outside the rhombus shaped figure → Flipped horizontally.

4) For the bottom most curved element → Flipped vertically.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3f01eaaa9abdcbd36d88c77892eec489105c4b00a0e52a241a03cb275da2e5d.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/adaaae7344a5a8bbf02a5e7c3a5d085f043b1a1b80236f9deed8f93c08fc120f.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
